title: Frontier: Simulating the Next Generation of LLM Inference Systems
authors: Yicheng Feng; Xin Tan; Kin Hang Sew; Yimin Jiang; Yibo Zhu; Hong Xu
venue_full: SIGCOMM Workshop on Networks for AI Computing (DOI 10.1145/3766882.3767173)
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, StepFun

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference simulators such as Vidur and LLMServingSim are built around a replica-centric abstraction that cannot natively represent disaggregated PD/AF architectures, MoE expert-parallelism, or system-level policies; their single-proxy-length attention surrogate also exhibits errors above 55% on batches with skewed sequence lengths.
problem_statement.zh: Vidur、LLMServingSim 等既有 LLM 推理模擬器以 replica 為中心進行抽象，無法原生表達 disaggregated PD/AF 架構、MoE expert parallelism 與系統層級策略；其以單一 proxy length 近似 attention 的方式在序列長度差異大的 batch 上誤差可超過 55%。

key_innovation.en: A stage-centric, event-driven simulator with a GlobalController + ClusterWorker hierarchy that natively models PD/AF disaggregation, MoE expert routing and GroupedGEMM straggler effects; uses a random-forest-based ExecutionPredictor over distributional sequence-length features and pluggable scheduling policies for vLLM/SGLang/TRT-LLM-style engines.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以階段為中心、事件驅動的模擬器，採用 GlobalController 與 ClusterWorker 階層架構，原生建模 PD/AF disaggregation、MoE expert routing 與 GroupedGEMM straggler 效應；以 random forest 為基礎的 ExecutionPredictor 利用序列長度的分布特徵建模，並提供可插拔的排程策略以模擬 vLLM、SGLang 與 TRT-LLM 等引擎。

key_improvements.en: Over 94% of Attention operator cases under 10% relative error and over 95% of GroupedGEMM cases under 6%, versus Vidur's >55% Attention error on skewed batches; end-to-end throughput prediction within 19.0%-23.2% relative error on a PD-disaggregated system.
key_improvements.zh: Attention 運算子超過 94% 的案例相對誤差小於 10%、GroupedGEMM 超過 95% 的案例小於 6%；相較 Vidur 在序列長度不均的 batch 上 Attention 誤差超過 55%；於 PD-disaggregated 系統上之端到端吞吐量預測的相對誤差落在 19.0% 至 23.2% 之間。

open_source: Not Specified (paper states plan to open source)
reported_accuracy: Attention >94% cases <10% error; GroupedGEMM >95% cases <6% error; end-to-end 19.0%-23.2% throughput error
validation_workloads: Synthetic batches sweeping batch size 4-32 with avg input 32-256 and output 128-1024 tokens; vLLM 0.10.1 with SharedStorageConnector KV interface

scope_assumptions.en: Operator-level focus on Attention and GroupedGEMM only; end-to-end validation limited to Qwen2-7B-Instruct and a 1:1 PD ratio; relies on pluggable scheduler/batching modules and ExecutionPredictor calibration per cluster.
scope_assumptions.zh: Operator 層級僅聚焦於 Attention 與 GroupedGEMM；端到端驗證僅限於 Qwen2-7B-Instruct 與 1:1 的 PD 比例；倚賴每個叢集的 ExecutionPredictor 校準，以及可插拔的 scheduler 與 batching 模組。
